## 🌟 Core Ayurvedic Disease Treatments & Formulations
EDUCA VEDA specializes in permanent root-cause healing where modern allopathic (angrezi) medicine only provides temporary symptom suppression while costing families ₹5 to 10 Lakhs and causing harmful secondary organ damage.

### 1. Shecurevedic (Women's Period Care & Gynaecological Health)
- **Target Audience**: Young girls and women aged 15–25 and above.
- **Problems Addressed**: Excruciating menstrual pain, severe lower-belly cramps, irregular blood flow, PCOD/PCOS, leucorrhoea, and hormonal imbalances.
- **Why Allopathy Fails**: Hospitals prescribe heavy hormone pills and painkillers costing lakhs of rupees that disrupt fertility, cause sudden weight gain, and lead to secondary complications.
- **EDUCA VEDA Shecurevedic Advantage**: 100% natural botanical rasayana that calms uterine spasms, normalizes menstrual cycle frequency and healthy blood flow. Verified positive patient feedback with complete relief from cramps and pain.

### 2. Madhumeha Sanjeevani (Diabetes / Sugar Root Cure)
- **Active Herbs**: Jamun seed, Karela extract, Gudmar, Vijaysar, Shuddh Shilajit.
- **Mechanism**: Rekindles natural pancreatic beta-cell insulin synthesis rather than artificially depleting the body. Helps patients break free from lifelong chemical tablet dependency.

### 3. Raktachap Nivaran (High Blood Pressure & Cardiac Health)
- **Active Herbs**: Sarpagandha, Arjuna chhal, Ashwagandha, Brahmi.
- **Mechanism**: Clears arterial plaque, relaxes vascular smooth muscle, and stabilizes both systolic and diastolic BP naturally.

### 4. Dant Suraksha Ras (Daat ki Dawa / Dental & Gum Care)
- **Active Herbs**: Laung (Clove oil), Babool bark, Akarkara, Neem, Camphor.
- **Problems Addressed**: Chronic toothache, bleeding gums, pyorrhea, tooth sensitivity, loose teeth. Permanent oral hygiene and enamel protection.
